wind.constraints: reported metrics only; not a preview interval

wind.reason: position fields are not equivalent to a user-defined northbound exposure

wind.fallback_gate: coverage count must be supplied explicitly

allowed_equivalents: explicit preview intervals with CNY profit and percent growth plus dated optional exposures under the exact runtime mapping
fallback_gate: preview intervals, fund exposure and research coverage are data_not_equivalent when absent; no inference is allowed
report_period_equivalence: every record report_period must equal parameters.report_period or data_not_equivalent is returned
input_file_gate: POSIX opens cwd then each directory component with dir_fd and no-follow before opening the final regular file; Windows verifies the opened handle final path and reparse state; unsafe or replaced paths fail closed
output_delivery: all input rows are processed; dataset_refs and source_hashes are limited to 32, copied text to 4096 characters, at most 128 rows are inline, row_delivery reuses canonical top-level refs without copying them, and the complete UTF-8 JSON envelope must be at most 64 KiB or return workload_too_large with reduce_scope
enablement_gate: initially disabled; catalog accepts only a strict evidence artifact path, recomputes artifact, input-source, packaged-golden, actual-result and calculate.py digests, persists the derived receipt, and re-verifies the unchanged artifact before enable or rollback-to-enabled
